entries.title: Lords of the Fallen
entries.definitive_edition: Lords of the Fallen Game of the Year Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the PC Game of the Year Edition or base game plus DLC.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with DLC/extras bundled.

primary.why: The Windows PC Game of the Year Edition is the best route because it includes the base game, Ancient Labyrinth campaign DLC, smaller DLC packs, soundtrack, and artbook while retaining PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Lords of the Fallen Game of the Year Edition on Steam/GOG-compatible PC storefronts, or buy the base Steam version plus Ancient Labyrinth and the other DLC packs. Play Ancient Labyrinth after the main campaign is underway.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the 2014 Deck13/CI Games game; keep it separate from the 2023 successor with the same title.

entries.title: Lords of the Fallen
entries.definitive_edition: Lords of the Fallen Version 2.0 on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the current patched PC build rather than the launch-state version.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with Version 2.0+ improvements.

primary.why: The Windows PC Version 2.0 route is the best version because the 2025 definitive update rolls in more than 50 post-launch updates, shared-progression co-op, Free Friend's Pass support, quality-of-life improvements, and the improved technical state while retaining PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Lords of the Fallen on Steam and update to the current Version 2.0+ build before starting. Use the updated build for solo play or shared-progression co-op.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the 2023 successor/reboot, not the 2014 game; Lords of the Fallen II is announced separately and should be revisited only after release.
